t: You're at Craven Hill Gardens, a classical Victorian residential estate in Lancaster Gate, Bayswater, with two small garden squares. Four rows of houses line its three streets, lying a short way north of Hyde Park. Edith Morley was born here. She became a literary scholar and suffrage campaigner, and a Fabian Society member. From 1908 she was Professor of English at University College, Reading, the first woman appointed to a chair at a British university-level institution.
